$comment: Modules the sdk-dev-qa skill can test. Paths are relative to this repo. Add a block per module; never edit the skill.

hosted-fields.title: Hosted Fields — card tokenization
setup: Get a .env from the team and put it in the repo root. Hosted fields needs SPREEDLY_ENVIRONMENT_KEY_NEW, CERTIFICATE_TOKEN_NEW, PRIVATE_KEY_NEW, SPREEDLY_ACCESS_SECRET_NEW, SPREEDLY_URL, and SPREEDLY_GATEWAY_TOKEN_NEW for purchase cases. Never commit it.
npm run dev — backend on http://localhost:3000. Or skip the .env and point pages at testData.apiBaseHeroku.
python3 -m http.server 4173 -d qa/hosted-fields/pages — serves the built pages for step 3.

testData.moreTestData: https://developer.spreedly.com/docs/test-data — includes cards that decline, for error cases

upstream: https://core-test.spreedly.com — Spreedly staging: tokenization API and the bundle CDN
https://checkout-web-sample-app-049a3c617015.herokuapp.com — the hosted backend, when used instead of localhost

seedDefects.note: every guide example now registers an event that never fires; token handling must come out BROKEN / doc wrong
